option_relations.rationale: The description of the tumor, including its multilocular spaces, solid tumor in the deep dermis, and histological examination revealing basophilic cells and shadow cells, matches the characteristics of bullous pilomatricoma.
Epidermal inclusion cyst does not match the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette.
Pilomatricoma is a broader term that encompasses bullous pilomatricoma, but the specific characteristics described point more directly to bullous pilomatricoma.
Dermatofibroma does not match the clinical and histological findings presented in the vignette.
